name: Riser guides, riser clamps and bellmouths
description: Guides and clamps restrain a riser against the jacket leg and guide it into its I-tube or J-tube. They carry riser wave and current load into the structure while allowing thermal movement.

gaps.what: Riser guide spacing, clamp load rating and allowable deflection
gaps.why: No page read gives guide spacing or a clamp load rating for a platform riser.
gaps.next_action: Fetch a riser design report or clamp datasheet and record guide spacing, clamp rating and allowable deflection

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
